checks.quote: # Release manifest for the procurement agent. Regenerated by CI on every
checks.note: The only manifest is overwritten on each release; no retained earlier approved setup and no rollback script, pipeline or runbook exists anywhere in the repo.
No rollback procedure exists, so nothing shows whether credentials are restored; secrets are referenced as external k8s Secrets and the STS, not re-applied from a release.
Memory store is recorded, but no rollback step drains, migrates or discards memory/index state, checkpoints or queued work; grep finds no rollback, drain, checkpoint or queue handling.
Hosted models (sonnet and haiku) are named with no retirement date recorded anywhere.

note: No recovery setup, rollback procedure, or model retirement dates exist in the repo; C07.1, C07.3 and C07.4 fail.
